name: Suibne Geilt
text: Suibne Geilt is the printed head for the mad king of the tale Buile Shuibne. The gloss geilt marks a person driven mad by terror. The fuller record of the figure sits under the Suibhne blend node. That node already carries this head-form among its listed names.
